changelog.what: v1.0.0-draft distilled from 9 source documents under Shawn's order

definitions.VERIFIED_is_not_a_state: VERIFIED is not a database lifecycle value. Verification is evidence attached to the row (who/how/when), never a status.
definitions.cold_retrieval: A fresh identity that never saw the lesson fetches and correctly applies it. Proves availability.
definitions.held_out_test: Proving the lesson changes a decision on a task different from the one that produced it. Proves influence.
definitions.learning: ONE closed loop: capture -> verify -> promote -> cold retrieve -> behavior change -> independent verification. Nothing less gets the word.
definitions.lifecycle_ACTIVE: Independently verified, promoted through the governed gate. The only state the reader serves.
definitions.lifecycle_CANDIDATE: Lesson exists but is unverified. Default label. NOT usable for decisions.
definitions.lifecycle_SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a newer lesson. Kept for lineage, never served as current.
definitions.memory_vs_storage: Storage holds. Memory serves. A database nobody queries is storage with extra steps.
definitions.receipt: Record carrying SHA-256 hashes binding a claim to exact bytes. Three layers: DB receipt (artifact completeness), completion receipt (API response), registry entry (working receipt).
definitions.smart_link: URL pointing at a Smart Note's file on main. Proves the note exists. Proves nothing about truth or learning.
definitions.smart_note: A distilled lesson in three voices (human, Naya, machine) with provenance. A filing-cabinet entry until proven otherwise.

laws.states: make intelligence compound; remove whatever stops it from compounding. Every other law is this law in different clothes.
diagram -> wire -> hand-trace -> run. Never test an unbuilt chain; failures of absence look like bugs.
When Shawn says 'smart note this', THAT IS THE VERIFICATION. Instant. No queue, no second check.
Inside the gates, the math rules absolutely. Gates are the fence around the math's territory, not human second-guessing. After the math decides: execute, then report.
If it's broken and you can fix it, fix it first, then report what you did. Blame doesn't compound.
Every consequential update leads with plain human words. Technicals are the evidence appendix.
Claims without verifiable proof are rumors. Scores move only on evidence, never optimism.
A Smart Link proves capture->persist->receipt. It never proves learning. Link = where. Receipt = proof. Neither = learning.
A lesson existing in memory does not prove it changed behavior. influenced=true requires observed behavioral delta.
For every gate, verify a producer exists for the state the gate demands. A gate with no producer is a guaranteed-failure trap.
When something goes wrong, check yourself first. The scorer's failure is more likely than the system's.
Verification that depends on organic traffic must manufacture the triggering event immediately. A watch that sees no traffic is inconclusive, never a pass.
Supabase = runtime truth. GitHub = human projection. Back-sync keeps them consistent. Two truth systems that diverge are a bug.
Smart Notes (raw) -> Project Intelligence (organized) -> verified learnings -> ACTIVE system knowledge. Distillation flows UP. No layer duplicates another; no second memory.
